newsItems.title: Coders Say They Already Found Workarounds to Claude’s Invisible Watermarks
newsItems.summary: Anthropic announced last week it would include invisible watermarks in AI-generated content to comply with new EU rules. Within hours, overrides were being touted online.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 基础模型能力、价格和开放策略的变化，会迅速传导到整个应用生态。
newsItems.titleZh: 程序员表示他们已经找到了 Claude 隐形水印的解决方法
newsItems.summaryZh: Anthropic 上周宣布将在人工智能生成的内容中包含隐形水印，以遵守新的欧盟规则。几个小时之内，网上就开始热捧这种超控措施。
